en: Black-and-white postcard view over the rooftops of a historic town toward a large hilltop complex. Dominating the skyline is a Gothic cathedral with tall twin spires, adjacent to a large castle-like building and other substantial stone structures, all surrounded by dense traditional houses with pitched roofs. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text identifying the scene.
